test_title: PYST 41: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 15 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. C sits second to the left of E. A sits second to the right of D. F is on the immediate right of A. Who is sitting on the immediate right of B?
solution:
**Given: **A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

1. C sits second to the left of E.

2, A sits second to the right of D.

3. F is on the immediate right of A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8276d7ae5423f2df27ab4117b45527801cd186d2f54cfe98b825ebee055dc094.png] 

B, the only person left will occupy the vacant position.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ae32577278c690ac070cb693daf0d328f6e033e7775559cded075946917e08e3.png] 

Thus, C is sitting on the immediate right of B.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
